slides.teacher_cue: New diphthong — /aʊ/. Two spellings: ou in the middle of a word (out, found, house), ow at the end (owl, town, down). Important: ow now has TWO sounds — /oʊ/ (snow, flow — Lesson 29) and /aʊ/ (down, town — today). Context and vocabulary help distinguish them. Mouth opens wide for /a/ then rounds for /ʊ/ — a full movement.
slides.expected_response: Students produce /aʊ/ cleanly and understand the ou/ow spellings — and that ow can make either /oʊ/ or /aʊ/.
slides.correction_move: Contrast ow = /oʊ/ (snow, slow, grow) vs ow = /aʊ/ (down, town, brown). Sort the two sets. Establish: context and meaning are the guide.
slides.observation_note: Watch for /oʊ/ substitution — students may default to the first ow sound they learned.

slides.slide_title: Say ou and ow /aʊ/ In Words
slides.teacher_cue: Say the new focus, then connect ou and ow /aʊ/ to one strong word from today.
slides.expected_response: Students say ou and ow /aʊ/ clearly and connect it to a lesson word.
slides.correction_move: Model the focus once, then have students echo and use it in a known word.
slides.observation_note: Listen for whether students can carry the focus from isolation into a real word.

slides.teacher_cue: Sight word — underlined. Say it as a whole unit. Uses r-controlled /aʊə/ — irregular vowel quality. Learn as a whole unit.
slides.expected_response: Students say our immediately as a whole unit.
slides.correction_move: Model our in a sentence, point to the underline, repeat chorally.
slides.observation_note: Watch for blending attempts. Redirect — sight word, say it whole.

slides.teacher_cue: Say out — not in. ou spelling. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say out orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model out orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for /aʊ/ — not /oʊ/ or /ʌ/.

slides.teacher_cue: Say found — past tense of find. ou vowel. Confirm /f/ onset. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say found orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model found orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for /p/ on /f/ and /aʊ/ in ou.

slides.teacher_cue: Say house — a building to live in. ou vowel, CVCe pattern. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say house orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model house orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for /aʊ/ in ou and the silent e making no difference to the vowel here.

slides.teacher_cue: Say town — a settlement. ow spelling at end this time — but this ow = /aʊ/ not /oʊ/. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say town orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model town orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for /aʊ/ in ow — students must distinguish from snow/slow.

slides.teacher_cue: Say down — toward the ground. ow = /aʊ/ here. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say down orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model down orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for /aʊ/ in ow and contrast with snow (ow = /oʊ/).

slides.teacher_cue: Say crown — a royal headdress. cr onset, ow = /aʊ/. Confirm /r/ in onset. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say crown orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model crown orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for /l/ on /r/ in onset and /aʊ/ in ow.
